g.text: Producing wells with a recorded event by each anniversary

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #333333

g.text: WARs record work after completion. Approvals cover classified well work. Age zero includes earlier qualifying events.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #333333

g.text: Each age uses wells spudded from 2005 onward with sufficient follow-up. Open markers indicate fewer than 10 eligible wells.
